newsitem.title: UK: July IPE gas oil delivery 122,300 tonnes - IPE.
newsitem.headline: July IPE gas oil delivery 122,300 tonnes - IPE.

text.p: Physical delivery against the expired IPE July gas oil futures contract will be 1,223 lots, or 122,300 tonnes, an IPE official said on Thursday.
Traders said the delivery was in line with expectations and should come largely from one major oil company.

Deliveries against the June contract totalled 1,360 lots or 136,000 tonnes. The November 1996 contract expiry saw a record 865,100 tonnes delivered and May 1996 saw the lowest delivery ever, of 12,600 tonnes.
